text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 9, 2025) for 5 Birchlea Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee – Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 9, 2025) for 5 Birchlea Avenue, Folder Number 25 156777 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to November 3, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
